runtimeArgs: const h=require('http'),f=require('fs'),p=require('path');const r=p.resolve('dist/pitch');const t={'.html':'text/html; charset=utf-8','.js':'text/javascript','.png':'image/png','.ttf':'font/ttf'};h.createServer((q,s)=>{let u=decodeURIComponent(q.url.split('?')[0]);if(!u.startsWith('/demo/')){s.writeHead(302,{location:'/demo/'});return s.end()}u=u.slice(6)||'index.html';if(u.startsWith('expo/'))u='_'+u;const fp=p.join(r,u);if(!fp.startsWith(r)){s.writeHead(403);return s.end()}f.readFile(fp,(e,d)=>{if(e){s.writeHead(404);return s.end('not found')}const x=p.extname(fp);if(x==='.html')d='<!doctype html><meta charset=utf-8><meta name=viewport content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1,viewport-fit=cover">'+d;s.writeHead(200,{'content-type':t[x]||'application/octet-stream'});s.end(d)})}).listen(8086)
